meta.name: GoJet Airlines LLC d/b/a United Express

validation.caveat: Both soi_planning and soi_historical use BTS T-100 monthly load factors as their capacity baseline because public datasets do not contain flight-level gate standby clearance outcomes. Therefore, time-based backtesting measures temporal consistency between advance-planning and post-hoc proxies rather than ground-truth non-rev boarding accuracy.
pillar2_nuances: Thanksgiving Sunday falls in December in 2019 (2019-12-01) and 2024 (2024-12-01); window lookup uses year-anchored 4th Thursday of November + 3 days without a month == 11 restriction.

In soi_planning, TSA (month, iso_dow, is_holiday_window) prior averaging blends Dec 1 Thanksgiving Sunday with Dec 22/29 holiday Sundays and blends Jan 15-31 troughs with Jan 1-14 holiday return weeks, narrowing soi_planning trough-vs-peak separation compared to soi_historical while keeping Welch p < 1e-100.
Christmas Eve/Day (Dec 24-25) flies lighter loads than Dec 20-23 & Dec 26-30, creating a bimodal sub-regime within the Dec 20-30 holiday window.
2019 flights have soi_planning = NULL (no prior training year), and 2026 data ends 2026-08-31 (covered in Jan/Mar windows, absent in Nov/Dec).
